name: History
notes: Six courses (24 credit hours) taken from department faculty.

Distribution requirements are NOT auto-enforced: the minor requires at least one course from each of two different geographical areas (Africa; Asia and the Pacific; Europe; Latin America; The Middle East; North America) and at least one course from each of two chronological periods (pre-1800, post-1800). The harvested catalog does not record a course's region or period, so the app counts the six courses and leaves the distribution to you and your adviser.

No more than two courses (8 credit hours) taken outside the department may count - this includes transfer, study-abroad, and cross-listed courses taught by faculty not formally associated with the department.
No more than a combined total of four elective credit hours (one course) for AP and IB exams.
